key_insight: A machine-learning-assisted workflow can rapidly shrink a huge CaCu$_5$-type composition space into a small set of promising magnetic candidates with favorable anisotropy.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster discovery of permanent magnet materials by filtering thousands of substitutions before costly first-principles calculations.
method: Applied screening for metallicity, negative formation energy, low hull energy, and predicted magnetization $�3f�3f$ wait
evidence_signal: From >60,000 generated structures, the screening pipeline reduced the set to 439 candidates for DFT, and 159 showed positive axial magnetic anisotropy.
watch_item: Model-based screening depends on thresholds and pretrained predictors, so promising candidates still require careful DFT validation and experimental follow-up.
paper_title: Data driven screening of CaCu$_5$-type magnetic structures
